rust.name: src/restates.rs:129:29: replace < with <= in copies
rust.why: The tests cover overlapping windows and runs separated by a line, leaving adjacent runs with no matching window between them unchecked.

rust.name: src/paragraph.rs:204:24: replace + with * in split

rust.name: src/paragraph.rs:186:32: replace + with * in split

rust.name: src/restates.rs:162:24: replace += with *= in fences
rust.why: The named-fence fixtures use one block each, so they would miss a copied window spanning two blocks that now share an ID.

rust.name: src/restates.rs:166:30: replace + with * in fences
rust.why: Every tested fenced copy ends before the closing delimiter, so leaving that delimiter out of the block could survive.
